title: Board Modifier Selection Modes
description: Board selection: add replace (default) merge mode; modifier chords Ctrl=subtractive, Shift=additive, Ctrl+Shift=invertive override toolbar mode on pointer; extend WASM pointerDownScreen with ctrl/meta flag; remove shift+empty pan (middle-button pan only). Update play toolbar default to replace and add Replace control.
summary: Area-select modifier chord bridge (window keydown/keyup during marquee) now only runs for physical modifier keys (Shift/Ctrl/Meta/Alt via event.code) and ignores event.repeat. Other hotkeys no longer call pointerMoveScreen with wrong modifier state, which was clearing or corrupting the live selection display.
